text:
inc-bot: Pager: HIGH — org=moonbeam, svc=generate-chat, error_rate=12.3%, p95 latency=1.8s, qps spike from 150->900 in 5m :rotating_light:

alice_ops: acknowledging, taking lead. oncall: @dmitri_oncall

dmitri_oncall: seeing a spike and 500s trending from the reranker. looks like repeated rerank calls on long contexts.

carla_sre: confirmed. Top traces show KV cache churn + large batch sizes. Customers hitting /v1/chat with tool-calls and long history.

ben_cs: reached out to Moonbeam; they say they rolled a new client version that increased concurrency. They're aware and can toggle a flag if needed.

inc-bot: Incident created: INC-7950001234 — "moonbeam high qps + 5xx"

alice_ops: mitigation plan: 1) apply temporary org-level rate limit bump to avoid global cascading failures (reduce concurrency per-org but not block) 2) disable reranker feature for moonbeam (heavy endpoint) 3) rollback smart-batching for that org (force smaller batch) 4) monitor 5xx and latency.

dmitri_oncall: doing step 1 — applying targeted RL change now:
```
# run on controlplane
apply-org-rl --org moonbeam --qps 300 --burst 600 --reason "emergency: sudden client concurrency spike"
```

inc-bot: Command accepted by controlplane; change pushed to edge proxies 

carla_sre: step 2: disabling reranker for moonbeam via feature-flag; command: 
```
ff-toggle --org moonbeam --flag reranker_enabled --set false --no-wait
```

inc-bot: Feature toggle applied to 3 regions (us-west1, us-east1, eu-west1).

kevin_prod: step 3: forcing per-org batch cap to 8 for generate-chat route for moonbeam.
```
config set route.generate-chat.batch_cap[org:moonbeam]=8
```

inc-bot: Changes live. Metrics pipeline delay ~20s.

eva_eng: watched the error rate — dropping from 12.3% -> 3.1% in last 2m. latency p95 also down to 1.1s. Nice work.

dmitri_oncall: holding monitoring. tagging for oncall handoff in 30m if stable. next steps: patch to customer quotas and CS note.

ben_cs: sharing update to Moonbeam: "We've applied temporary rate protections and disabled reranker to stabilize traffic. Please roll back client change or lower concurrency. We'll keep you posted."

carla_sre: quick note: disabled reranker will change output quality; CS to warn customer about regressions. Also saving config diffs and logs to incident ticket INC-7950001234.

alice_ops: after 10m of stable metrics, we should gradually raise qps to acceptable baseline to avoid a backlog spike. propose incremental bump to 450 qps in 10m if error_rate < 1.5%. Agree?

dmitri_oncall: agree. scheduling staged bump:
```
schedule-rl-change --org moonbeam --to 450 --at +10m --stagger 5m
```

inc-bot: Scheduled RL change accepted.

eva_eng: note for postmortem: root cause hypothesis: client-side change removed a concurrency backoff, amplifying a hot prefix pattern that thrashes KV cache and reranker. We'll capture traces for the failing requests.

alice_ops: handoff to @dmitri_oncall for monitoring and to @carla_sre for rollback plan. @ben_cs please confirm customer will pause deploy.

ben_cs: Moonbeam confirms they paused the release and will rollout a client throttling patch within the hour. They've asked for temporary allowance to hit 450 qps once stabilized.

dmitri_oncall: 20m post-mitigation update: error_rate 0.9%, p95 0.95s, qps steady ~420. Proceeding with scheduled bump at +10m.

inc-bot: RL bump executed (450). Monitoring...

carla_sre: after bump, slight increase to 1.4% errors for 2m then back to 0.8%. Looks good.

alice_ops: moving incident to 'monitoring' and prepping follow-up: action items: - permanent org quota review - add per-route circuit breaker for reranker - add client guidance to quickstart to prefer smaller concurrency for long-history chats - postmortem in 48h.

ben_cs: I'll schedule a customer debrief and include quality caveat from reranker being disabled.

dmitri_oncall: handing off to @carla_sre for next 6h watch. Summary: temp RL applied, reranker disabled, batch cap lowered; customer paused deploy and will patch. Metrics stable.

carla_sre: acknowledged handoff. marking incident as "stabilized" in ticket. will escalate if error_rate > 2% or latency p95 > 1.6s.

inc-bot: Incident INC-7950001234 status: stabilized -> monitoring. Tags: rate-limit, org-mitigation, feature-flag, customer-contact.

alice_ops: thanks team. postmortem owner: @eva_eng. draft due in 48h. :white_check_mark:
